item.title: Overview of Zechariah - Hope Beyond the Ruins 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Imagine being part of a family that has spent years dreaming about returning home. As a child, you heard stories about the place from older relatives who remembered its former glory. They described a beautiful city filled with worship, security, and joy. They spoke of a magnificent temple where the presence of God dwelt among His people. They told stories about a great king from David’s line who would one day rule in righteousness and bring peace, not only to Israel but to the nations. These stories became part of your identity. They shaped your hopes and sustained your family through years of hardship.
